summary: Promoted the skills editor from a modal opened from Settings → Agent into its own full settings page (#settings/skills) with a split workbench: a searchable skill library on the left and the selected skill's Markdown editor on the right. Added a 'skills' entry to settingsPages/router, updated AgentSettings/SettingsScreen/SkillList/SkillEditor and related CSS, refined styling (softened accent border, switched to design-system success color), fixed mobile layout wrap and surfaced resource errors on the Agent page, then ran svelte-check, vitest, and headless screenshots for review.
decisions: Skills editor is a standalone settings page at hash #settings/skills, not a modal; 'skills' was added to settingsPages and router types/tests.
Skills page uses a split workbench layout: SkillList on the left, SkillEditor (inline, non-dialog) on the right, chosen over a list-only or fullscreen-editor alternative.
SettingsScreen now also passes the `layout` prop through to AgentSettings so resource errors and other store-backed UI can be surfaced there.
Reduced the changed-state accent border from 3px to 1px and replaced the literal #4ade80 with the design-system --color-success token to avoid slop/anti-pattern findings from the impeccable detector.
On the Skills page, the settings header and action rows are allowed to wrap so mobile widths don't overflow.
errors: Impeccable detect flagged a 'side-tab accent border' (3px inset stripe) on the changed-state rows in settings.css and a literal #4ade80 color outside DESIGN.md; both were resolved by softening the stripe to 1px and switching to var(--color-success).
